bear_assumptions: Growth decelerates toward the low teens, marketplace gross margin fails to expand, cash conversion weakens and dilution approaches 60 million shares; about 3x forward revenue plus reduced net cash.
base_assumptions: Revenue grows around 20%, gross margin remains near the high-thirties, operating leverage continues but GAAP profitability remains limited, and dilution reaches about 59 million shares; about 4.5x forward revenue plus net liquidity.
bull_assumptions: Revenue growth remains near 30%, data-driven pricing and routing lift gross profit, durable positive free cash flow emerges and dilution is contained; about 6x forward revenue plus net liquidity.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary evidence raises base and confidence-adjusted expected returns above canonical gates, downside payoff improves, cash conversion persists and the candidate relationship is accepted; downgrade if marketplace growth, gross profit, buyer quality, supplier performance, cash conversion or dilution deteriorates.
